title: How to save 15% on Netflix using Itunes Gift Card
description: Step by step guide from finding discounted iTunes gift card to using it for Netflix.  This applies to other Apple subscriptions as well!

asr.full_text: Hey guys, it's Ryan, the Frugal Analyst, and in this video I'm gonna show you how to save 15% or more on your Netflix subscription using iTunes gift card. Now if you're frugal like me, you're probably already sharing your Netflix account. But still, somebody is still footing the bill, and if you can save a couple more dollars, why not? And I never wanna pay full price. So these deals to buy a discount on iTunes gift card happens all the time. In the last three months, I saw nine deals from Costco, Amazon, eBay, Target. I mean, these are big name store that's selling these gift cards at a discount. I bought this gift card, $100 gift card for $85 from Costco last February 2018. Now to use this deal, you do need to have an Apple device like an iPhone or an iPad where you can subscribe Netflix through iTunes. The first step is to buy the discounted gift card. My favorite way to search for these deals is to use a website called Slick Deals. Go to slickdeals.com, make an account, and set a deal alert Slick Deals. Go to slickdeals.com, make an account, and set a deal alert for iTunes gift card. Therefore, if there is a new deal that comes up, you get notified by email. Once you get your gift card, load these gift card into your iTunes account. And I'm going to show you through a screen capture from my iPhone. All right, starting with the iTunes gift card and we have my iPhone 6s Plus. Let's open up the gift card. Let's stack them all down. Now in the iPhone, go open up your iPhone and go to the App Store. Here in the top right, you have your icon. Click that icon click redeem gift card or code and you can use the camera to scan your gift card I just realized that you actually have to scratch the code on pop so let's scratch it now it finally works $25 is loaded you do the same for all the other gift card now that you have your gift card loaded into your Apple account download the Netflix app now you can actually use the gift card for other apps other than Netflix like Spotify, Pandora etc but I'm showing you Netflix because I'm resubscribing to Netflix so now that you have the app go log into Netflix Click the red button on the bottom. Type your Apple ID login. the plan you want and click continue now the key here is subscribe with itunes now you can just pay with apple pay put in your fingerprint We're at the bottom of our list and we've made the click. Now you can just pay with Apple Pay, put in your fingerprint and you're all set. So if you're successful, when they charge your account, Apple will send you an email, it will look something like this and what you see here is where it says built to, it's going to show as Store Credit. And when it does that, you're actually using your iTunes gift card – and if you get it at a discount rate, you'll get a discounted Netflix account as well. So thank you guys for watching. If you want to hear more videos to save money, please hit the subscribe button and please comment if you're going it will be a better fit.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a consumer-finance tutorial on finding discounted iTunes gift cards and applying the balance toward a Netflix subscription. The visible Apple and Netflix screens match the described redemption and subscription steps, and the request to subscribe and comment is ordinary audience engagement rather than a condition for receiving money. The material does not describe solicitation of investments, private credentials, or payment to the speaker.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary discount promotion and redemption tutorial: the speaker describes buying discounted iTunes gift cards and applying the balance to a Netflix subscription. The supplied evidence does not show a free-gift claim, survey requirement, task-based income flow, or sensitive-data harvesting mechanism.
